name: Organic Structure Determination by Spectroscopy
summary: Using IR, NMR, mass spectrometry and UV-vis together to work out the structure of an unknown organic compound.

topics.name: Degree of unsaturation from the molecular formula
Mass spectrometry: molecular ion, isotope patterns and fragmentation
¹H NMR: chemical shift, integration and spin-spin coupling
2D NMR: COSY, HSQC, HMBC and NOESY
Coupling constants, the Karplus relation and stereochemical assignment
Chiroptical methods and X-ray confirmation of structure
